name: Garlicky Swiss Chard With Serrano and Lemon

ingredients.name: serrano pepper, stemmed and thinly sliced
Swiss chard, stemmed, leaves separated, and chopped
kosher salt, plus more to taste
fresh lemon juice, from 1 lemon plus more to taste

instructions.primary_message: In a large Dutch oven or deep skillet, heat olive oil and garlic over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and lightly golden, 4 to 6 minutes.

Add serrano and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add chard leaves in three or four batches, tossing and covering for about 1 minute between additions to help the greens wilt and make room for more. Once all the chard has been added, uncover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the leaves are tender and most of the released liquid has evaporated, 4 to 6 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice. Season with salt and lemon juice to taste. Serve warm.

schema_metadata.keywords: Swiss chard, Swiss chard recipe, sautéed Swiss chard, serrano pepper recipes, lemony Swiss chard, garlic Swiss chard, easy vegetable side dish

description: Swiss chard is cooked with plenty of garlic, olive oil, serrano, and lemon for a tender, punchy green side dish that pairs with almost any meal.
notes:
Notes: Swiss chard stems have a pleasant crunch and mild, earthy flavor. To include them, thinly slice the stems and add them once the garlic has softened but before it begins to brown. Cook until crisp-tender, then add the serrano and proceed with the recipe.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
